facebook.text:
The no-designer brand check.

Save the rules once: approved colors, fonts, and logo together in one brand kit. After that you stop debating layouts and focus on whether the message is clear. Posts made by different people still feel like one brand. Before you publish, you check the headline, spacing, and logo. The brand part is already handled in every format.

Swipe for the five-slide version. poaster.co, 3 downloads free before you create an account.
